title: Germy
description: My first ever app—a Pandemic-era Tetris inspired experiment.
longDescription: Started in 2020, Germy was the project where I taught myself Flutter. Originally a pandemic-themed game, it faced multiple App Store rejections due to sensitivity policies and gameplay similarities. Despite not hitting Apple's store, it reached the Play Store and serves as the technical foundation for everything I build today.

title: APEify
description: My first major success story. An avatar creator that grew to 70k+ organic downloads through viral social trends.
longDescription: APEify is a character tracking and progression app that allows users to manage their character data, save progress via Firebase, and interact with a premium UI. It remains one of the core active projects in the ecosystem.

title: Ten Beer Plan
description: My first custom backend journey—a social coordination MVP born from a meme.
longDescription: Ten Beer Plan was a technical milestone where I built my first personal backend using Python, Flask, and SQLAlchemy. It was an MVP tested by a small group of users, but ultimately hit a roadblock with Apple's sensitivity policies regarding alcohol content. It served as a massive learning experience for authentication, database management, and AWS deployment.

title: House Price Alerts
description: Real-time alerts for property market shifts.
longDescription: Technically complete but strategically paused. Following the 'User-First' philosophy of Project Northstar, this app's release is pending proven user demand to ensure the development effort matches market interest.

title: Earn Your Beers
description: Log your drinks and earn them back through exercise (running or cycling).
longDescription: A simple offline app built for a friend. Log your drinks in real-time and commit to a corresponding run or cycle. Designed for iterative testing and community-driven feature ideas.

title: Personal Habit Tracker
description: A bespoke habit tracker tailored to my exact rituals and growth goals.
longDescription: A custom tool built to track positive daily habits and rituals. Part of a 'habit of sharing' series on YouTube, this project focuses on personal utility first—tracking everything from sleep and nutrition to push-ups and gift-giving.
features: Upper body workout / Press ups / Stretch

title: Macro Metrics
description: A personal dashboard for tracking macro-level growth metrics across the portfolio — MAU, subscriber counts, and channel performance.
longDescription: A tool built to give a single view of top-level growth signals across all projects and channels. Tracks monthly active users, YouTube subscriber growth, newsletter signups, and other macro indicators to inform sprint priorities and long-term direction.

title: Transcription Driven Video Editor
description: An AI-powered tool that lets you edit video by editing text — cut footage by deleting words, not scrubbing timelines.
longDescription: Video editing is a time-consuming chore. This tool transcribes your footage into text and lets you edit the video by interacting with the transcript — delete a sentence, cut the clip. Filler word removal, natural gap management, and a credit-based model if it proves useful to others.

title: Commuter House Search
description: The 'Skyscanner for Houses'—search for your next home based on commute time, not just distance.
longDescription: A potential disruption to traditional real estate searching. Instead of radius-based searches, users can find properties based on their actual commute duration to work or other key locations.
